source.name: OmniSource
source.subtitle: A curated iOS app source for AltStore, SideStore, Feather, ESign and LiveContainer
source.description: OmniSource is a curated, automatically maintained AltStore-compatible iOS app source. Every entry is resolved from the app's own official upstream project - GitHub Releases or the developer's official AltStore feed - and each download link is re-verified automatically.

apps.name: SpotiFLAC Mobile
apps.subtitle: FLAC Downloader for iOS
apps.localizedDescription: SpotiFLAC Mobile is an open-source Spotify track and playlist metadata downloader and FLAC converter for iOS and Android. Search and download high-quality FLAC and MP3 audio with complete ID3 metadata, embedded album artwork, and synchronized lyrics directly on your device.

apps.name: uYouEnhanced
apps.subtitle: uYouPlus with even more features!
apps.localizedDescription: uYou is the best tweak for the YouTube app. uYouEnhanced is a modified version of qnblackcat's uYouPlus & MiRO92's uYou with even more features. Additional features include skipping sponsorships in videos, more PiP options, unlocking higher resolutions, disabling overlays, removing upsell alerts, dimming the UI, enabling the miniplayer, preventing notch issues, configuring A/B settings, and adding a timestamp button.

verification.publisher: Community build of arichornlover/uYouEnhanced, mirrored on archive.org

compatibility.notes: uYouEnhanced's official GitHub releases publish release notes only - no .ipa assets - so the IPA served here is a community build of the official release tag (YouTube 21.14.4 / uYou 3.0.5), mirrored on archive.org. Once a 'Build uYouEnhanced' run publishes an IPA in this repository (tag uyouenhanced-v*), the self-built artifact takes over automatically.

It provides complete ad blocking, background playback, offline video and audio downloads, Picture-in-Picture (PiP), SponsorBlock integration, gesture controls, and customizable interface settings.

apps.name: UTM
apps.subtitle: Virtual machines for iOS
apps.localizedDescription:
Run real operating systems on your iPhone or iPad. UTM is an open-source (Apache-2.0) virtualization and emulation platform built on QEMU, capable of running Windows, Linux, classic Mac OS and dozens of other systems alongside your apps.

Highlights:
- QEMU v10.0.2 backend with support for dozens of CPU architectures (x86_64, ARM64, RISC-V, PowerPC and more)
- Improved machine wizard with well-tested configurations such as Windows, Ubuntu, RISC-V64 Ubuntu, classic Mac OS 8.x/9.x and Windows 95/98
- Custom keyboard shortcuts (e.g. Ctrl+Alt+Del) sent directly to the VM from the Keyboard menu
- App Intents automation with the Shortcuts app
- Liquid Glass design on iOS 26
- Import and export .utm virtual machine bundles via the Files app
- No jailbreak required; highest performance with JIT workarounds on supported iOS versions

compatibility.notes: Universal IPA. The QEMU (SE) backend runs on any iOS 14+ device; virtualization (HV) acceleration requires a supported device plus a JIT workaround or jailbreak. 4 GB of RAM or more is recommended for usable guest performance.

permissions.usageDescription: Permission is required for any virtual machine to record from the microphone.
UTM requests location data periodically to ensure the system keeps the background process active. Location data will never leave the device.

privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Permission is required for any virtual machine to record from the microphone.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: UTM requests location data periodically to ensure the system keeps the background process active. Location data will never leave the device.
privacy.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: UTM requests location data periodically to ensure the system keeps the background process active. Location data will never leave the device.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: The virtual machine may access the local network. UTM may also use the network to communicate with local servers.

apps.name: iNKillerPlus
apps.subtitle: Instagram with downloads, ghost mode and no ads
apps.localizedDescription: iNKillerPlus is a modified Instagram by iKarwan. Download posts, reels, stories and DM media, save profile pictures, block promoted posts and ads, toggle seen/unseen for stories and DMs, ghost typing, hide tabs, copy comments and bios, confirmation prompts before liking or calling, and a profile analyzer. iPadOS supported.

apps.name: Winston
apps.subtitle: Open-source Reddit client
apps.localizedDescription: Winston is a beautiful open-source Reddit client for iOS built in SwiftUI, with themes, gestures, an inline media viewer and a fast comment thread reader. Because Reddit charges for API access, Winston asks you to create your own free Reddit API credentials on first launch.

compatibility.notes: Official GPL-3.0 releases from lo-cafe/winston. The last published build is v1.1.5 (June 2024); the project is on hold, so treat it as archived-but-installable. Requires your own Reddit API credentials.

apps.name: iTorrent
apps.subtitle: Torrent client with a built-in player
apps.localizedDescription: iTorrent is a fully featured open-source torrent client for iOS. It keeps downloading in the background, integrates with the Files app, supports magnet links, sequential download and per-file selection, and ships a built-in VLC-based player with Picture in Picture, audio and subtitle tracks and playback speed control.

compatibility.notes: Official MIT-licensed releases from XITRIX/iTorrent.

apps.name: StikDebug
apps.subtitle: On-device JIT enabler and debugger
apps.localizedDescription: StikDebug attaches a debugger to your sideloaded apps directly on device, which enables JIT for emulators and other apps that need it. It uses a pairing file and an on-device VPN loop, so no computer is required after the initial setup. Requires iOS 17.4 or newer.

compatibility.notes: Official releases from StikDebug/StikDebug. Needs a pairing file and the on-device VPN loop; JIT attachment requires iOS 17.4 or newer.

apps.name: BHTwitter
apps.subtitle: X (Twitter) with no ads, downloads and the chronological timeline
apps.localizedDescription: BHTwitter is a long-running tweak for X (formerly Twitter), published as a ready-to-sideload IPA. It hides promoted posts and ads, restores the chronological timeline as the default, and lets you download videos, GIFs and images straight from a post. It also adds Face ID / Touch ID app lock, custom fonts, undo posting, inline translation, direct saving of profile pictures and headers, confirmation prompts for likes and reposts, and switches for hiding the tabs and UI elements you never use.

compatibility.notes: Official sideloaded build from BandarHL/BHTwitter. The release also ships a TrollStore .tipa, which OmniSource skips - only the -sideloaded.ipa is tracked. The bundled X app is whichever decrypted build the maintainer packaged for that tweak release.

apps.name: LiveContainer
apps.subtitle: Run iOS apps without actually installing them
apps.localizedDescription: LiveContainer runs other iOS apps inside itself instead of installing them, so a single app slot on your certificate can host many sideloaded apps and you stop burning through the 3-app limit. When JIT is available it bypasses codesigning entirely; otherwise guest apps are signed with the same certificate as LiveContainer. It supports multiple data containers per app, tweak injection, adding guest apps to the Home Screen, and multitasking windows on iPadOS 16 and later.

compatibility.notes: Official AGPL-3.0 releases. The plain LiveContainer.ipa is tracked; the LiveContainer+SideStore.ipa bundle in the same release is skipped. Multitasking needs iPadOS 16 or later, and installing guest apps needs AltStore 2.0+ / SideStore 0.6.0+.

apps.name: Feather
apps.subtitle: On-device app manager, signer and installer
apps.localizedDescription: Feather is a free on-device iOS and iPadOS application manager built with UIKit. Import your own developer or enterprise certificate to sign and install IPAs directly from the device, add AltStore-compatible repositories to browse and update apps, keep a library of signed and imported apps, and tweak bundle identifiers, display names, icons and injected dylibs per app - no computer or AltServer required.

compatibility.notes: Official GPL-3.0 releases from claration/Feather (formerly khcrysalis/Feather). You need your own signing certificate; Feather does not provide one.

apps.name: SideStore
apps.subtitle: AltStore fork that refreshes apps without a computer
apps.localizedDescription: SideStore is a fork of AltStore that signs and refreshes sideloaded apps directly on the device. After a one-time pairing-file setup it renews 7-day certificates in the background using your own Apple ID and an anisette server, so apps stop expiring while you are away from a computer. It installs apps from any AltStore-compatible source, keeps them updated, and can back up and restore app data.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: SideStore can use local network access to discover Bonjour (mDNS) services on your network. This is not required for core functionality.

compatibility.notes: Official AGPL-3.0 stable releases; the rolling nightly and alpha tags are pre-releases and are not tracked. Requires a pairing file and, on iOS 17+, a JIT/StikDebug-style enabler for some features.

apps.name: Aidoku
apps.subtitle: Free and open-source manga reader
apps.localizedDescription: Aidoku is a free and open-source manga reader for iOS and iPadOS with no ads and no tracking. Content comes from community-maintained source lists that you add yourself, so nothing is bundled with the app. It downloads chapters for offline reading, syncs library, history and settings through iCloud, supports external trackers, and offers paged, vertical and continuous reading modes with customisable layouts.

compatibility.notes: Official releases from Aidoku/Aidoku. Sources are added by the user; the app ships none.

apps.name: Provenance
apps.subtitle: Multi-system retro game emulator
apps.localizedDescription: Provenance is a multi-emulator front-end covering Atari, Bandai, NEC, Nintendo, Sega, SNK and Sony systems from a single library. It handles save states, cheats, MFi and native game controllers, Metal-based scaling filters, per-core settings, and imports your own ROMs and BIOS files through the Files app, iCloud or its built-in web uploader.

compatibility.notes: Official stable releases; the rolling alpha tag is a pre-release and is not tracked. The iOS IPA is around 1 GB because every emulator core is bundled, and the tvOS build is skipped. Provenance ships no games - you supply your own ROMs.

apps.name: Delta
apps.subtitle: All-in-one retro emulator by Riley Testut
apps.localizedDescription: Delta is an all-in-one classic video game emulator for non-jailbroken iOS devices, developed by Riley Testut as the spiritual successor to GBA4iOS. It emulates the Nintendo systems (Game Boy Color, Game Boy Advance, Nintendo DS, Nintendo 64, SNES, NES) plus Sega Genesis and Game Gear, with save states and cheats, controller and Nintendo DS skin support, iCloud sync of saves, and full MFi/Bluetooth controller support.

compatibility.notes: Official IPA published by the developer on GitHub Releases. Uses the same bundle identifier as the App Store build of Delta: installing the sideload build replaces the store version. Delta 1.6 targets iOS 14 or newer.

apps.name: PPSSPP
apps.subtitle: Fast PlayStation Portable (PSP) emulator
apps.localizedDescription: PPSSPP is a fast and portable PlayStation Portable (PSP) emulator developed by Henrik Rydgård. It runs PSP games at up to double native resolution with anisotropic filtering and shader effects, supports save states anywhere, hardware controllers, and needs no BIOS file thanks to its high-level emulation approach.

compatibility.notes: Official release IPA (PPSSPP-iOS-<version>.ipa) from the developer's GitHub releases, with Metal rendering via the bundled MoltenVK. The upstream CMake config sets the iOS deployment target to 12.0. The same release page also ships a jailbreak .deb package.

apps.name: Yattee
apps.subtitle: Privacy-oriented native video player
apps.localizedDescription: Yattee is a privacy-oriented, fully native video player for iPhone, iPad and Apple TV. It plays from user-configured Invidious or Piped backends and local video libraries, with SponsorBlock, chapters, background audio, Picture in Picture, subscriptions, and full keyboard and remote control support.

compatibility.notes: Official iOS IPA (Yattee-<version>-iOS.ipa) from the developer's GitHub releases. Yattee 1.5.1 targets iOS 14 or newer. The same release ships separate macOS and tvOS builds which are not distributed here.

apps.name: Streamyfin
apps.subtitle: Open-source Jellyfin client for iOS
apps.localizedDescription: Streamyfin is an open-source Jellyfin client for iPhone and iPad built with Expo and React Native. Stream your Jellyfin server's library with offline downloads, background audio, Picture in Picture, Chromecast, intro skipping, live TV, and an optional MPV-based player — no server plugins required.

compatibility.notes: Official unsigned CI IPA (streamyfin-ios.ipa) built by the developer's GitHub release pipeline. Requires a Jellyfin server to connect to. The streamyfin-ios-tv.ipa asset in the same release is a separate Apple TV build and is intentionally not distributed here.

apps.name: Spotube
apps.subtitle: Open-source Spotify music client
apps.localizedDescription: Spotube is an open-source, cross-platform music streaming client that combines Spotify's metadata — your playlists, albums, liked songs and recommendations — with community audio sources, so you can play your whole Spotify library without ads or telemetry. Includes lyrics and a plugin system for extending playback sources.

compatibility.notes: Official release IPA (Spotube-iOS.ipa, stable flavor) built by the developer's release pipeline and published with SHA-256/MD5 checksum files. It does not conflict with the official Spotify app. Android and desktop builds ship in the same release.

apps.name: Jellify
apps.subtitle: Native Jellyfin music player for iOS
apps.localizedDescription: Jellify is a free and open-source music player for Jellyfin, built with React Native. Browse and stream your Jellyfin music libraries on iPhone and iPad with a native interface, fast search, playlists, favorites and now-playing controls — available on the App Store and as sideload builds.

compatibility.notes: Official unsigned IPA (Jellify-<version>.ipa) from the developer's GitHub releases. Requires a Jellyfin server to connect to. Android builds ship in the same release.

apps.name: Zeus
apps.subtitle: Self-custodial Bitcoin and Lightning wallet
apps.localizedDescription: Zeus is a free and open-source, self-custodial Bitcoin and Lightning wallet for iPhone and iPad. Connect the app to your own node (LND, Core Lightning, c-lightning-REST, BTCPay Server or Lightning Terminal) or use the built-in Olympus LNDHub for a quick start, with contacts, Nostr Wallet Connect, LNURL, point-of-sale and full on-chain and Lightning payment support.

compatibility.notes: Official unsigned IPA built by the ZeusLN release pipeline (v13.x targets iOS 15.1). A self-custody wallet: point it at your own Lightning node for full sovereignty.

apps.name: BlueWallet
apps.subtitle: Open-source Bitcoin wallet for iOS
apps.localizedDescription: BlueWallet is a free and open-source Bitcoin wallet focused on simplicity and power. Create standard on-chain wallets, watch-only wallets with full PSBT and hardware-wallet support, and Lightning wallets backed by the built-in LNDHUB or your own node — with fee control, multisig (Vault) and Tor connectivity.

compatibility.notes: Official unsigned IPA published by the BlueWallet team on GitHub Releases (8.x targets iOS 15.6). Uses the same bundle identifier as the App Store build: installing the sideload build replaces the store version.

apps.name: Voyager
apps.subtitle: Beautiful open-source client for Lemmy
apps.localizedDescription: Voyager is a free and open-source client for Lemmy and PieFed with an iOS-native feel — swipe gestures, haptics, infinite scroll, rich markdown support, multi-account switching and deep theming. The same project powers the official Voyager App Store release; this feed tracks the developer's own GitHub build.

compatibility.notes: Official unsigned iOS IPA (Voyager-iOS-<version>.ipa) from the developer's GitHub releases; 2.x targets iOS 15. The release also ships Android (apk) and watch builds which are intentionally not distributed here.

apps.name: Saber
apps.subtitle: Open-source handwritten notes
apps.localizedDescription: Saber is a free and open-source handwritten notes app built with Flutter. Write with your finger or Apple Pencil as if on paper, organize notes into folders, keep them private with encryption, and sync across devices using its optional Nextcloud-based sync — no vendor lock-in.

compatibility.notes: Official unsigned IPA (Saber_v<version>.ipa) from the developer's GitHub releases; 1.x targets iOS 15. Also available on the App Store under the same bundle identifier.

apps.name: Anx Reader
apps.subtitle: Open-source e-book reader with AI
apps.localizedDescription: Anx Reader is a free and open-source e-book reader for iPhone and iPad. Read EPUB, MOBI and other formats with a polished reader engine, AI-powered summaries and translations (bring your own key), text-to-speech, highlights and notes, reading statistics, and WebDAV sync across devices.

compatibility.notes: Official unsigned CI IPA (Anx-Reader-ios-<version>-unsigned.ipa) built by the developer's release pipeline; 1.x targets iOS 15.2.

apps.name: Apollo
apps.subtitle: The beloved Reddit client, continued by Apollo-Reborn
apps.localizedDescription: Apollo was the beloved, award-winning Reddit client for iPhone and iPad known for its beautiful native interface, powerful gestures, jump-to-comments, inline media reading and fanatic attention to detail. After Reddit's API changes ended the original app, the Apollo-Reborn project now publishes official continuation builds that work against Reddit's public API — keeping the classic Apollo experience alive.

compatibility.notes: Official Apollo-Reborn builds from the project's own GitHub releases (deployment target iOS 14 per the build config). The standard variant is distributed here; the project also publishes Liquid Glass and icon variants on the same release. The long-standing Balackburn/Apollo AltStore source mirrors these same builds.

apps.name: DolphiniOS
apps.subtitle: GameCube and Wii emulator for iOS
apps.localizedDescription: DolphiniOS is the Dolphin GameCube and Wii emulator ported to iOS by OatmealDome, requiring no jailbreak. It runs the full Dolphin core with Metal rendering via MoltenVK, supports controllers, save states and high-resolution rendering, and plays your legally dumped GameCube and Wii games.

compatibility.notes: Official Non-Jailbroken IPA from the developer's GitHub releases (DolphiniOS 5.0 beta line, iOS 14+). This feed tracks the current 5.0 beta channel — every published build so far is tagged as a pre-release upstream. The same release also ships jailbreak .deb packages and a TrollStore .tipa.

apps.name: iSH
apps.subtitle: Linux shell on iOS via x86 emulation
apps.localizedDescription: iSH is an open-source project that runs a Linux shell environment on iOS using a user-mode x86 emulator. It provides Alpine Linux with the APK package manager, so you can install and run familiar command-line tools — ssh, git, python, vim and more — entirely on your iPhone or iPad, no jailbreak required.

compatibility.notes: The official iSH AltStore source (ish.app/altstore.json) serves exactly this channel: the newest iSH.ipa from the project's builds/* GitHub releases. iSH marks trunk builds as pre-releases; the last promoted stable was 1.3.2 (build 494). Reported version is the upstream build number.

apps.name: qBitControl
apps.subtitle: qBittorrent remote control for iOS
apps.localizedDescription: qBitControl is a native qBittorrent remote control app for iPhone and iPad. Manage your torrents from anywhere: add, pause, resume and recheck torrents, browse files and set priorities, configure speed and seeding limits, use custom HTTP headers and self-signed certificates, and track RSS feeds — all against your own qBittorrent WebUI.

compatibility.notes: Official release IPAs from the developer's GitHub releases (release-* tags, iOS 16+). The developer also publishes newer continuous builds under build-ci-* tags; this feed tracks the stable release channel.

apps.name: qBitConnect
apps.subtitle: Modern qBittorrent remote client
apps.localizedDescription: qBitConnect is a modern, open-source qBittorrent remote client for iPhone and iPad built with Flutter. Connect to your qBittorrent WebUI to add, manage and monitor torrents with a clean, adaptive interface, push notifications for finished downloads, RSS support and quick actions.

compatibility.notes: Official IPAs from the developer's own GitHub releases (iOS 15+ per the Xcode project). The developer's AltStore PAL source may carry newer builds from a separate pipeline; this feed tracks the signed-off GitHub release tags.

apps.name: VCMI
apps.subtitle: Open-source Heroes of Might & Magic III engine
apps.localizedDescription: VCMI is an open-source engine that re-implements Heroes of Might and Magic III so the classic turn-based strategy game runs on modern hardware — with widescreen and high-resolution support, extensive modding (including the popular HotA and Era mods), stabilized multiplayer and quality-of-life improvements over the original. Requires a copy of the original game's data files.

compatibility.notes: Official iOS IPA (VCMI-iOS.ipa) built by the VCMI project's release pipeline (iOS 13+ per the CMake configuration). You must supply data files from an original Heroes III (Shadow of Death or Complete edition) copy on first launch.

apps.name: MAME4iOS
apps.subtitle: Multi-arcade machine emulator for iOS
apps.localizedDescription: MAME4iOS brings the Multiple Arcade Machine Emulator to iPhone, iPad and Apple TV, running thousands of classic arcade games from the 70s, 80s, 90s and beyond. Includes an on-screen joystick, full MFi controller support, netplay, and a menu to organize your legally dumped ROM sets.

compatibility.notes: Official IPA from the developer's GitHub releases (2022.5 line, iOS 13.4+ per the Xcode project; also distributed via the SideStore Community Source). The same release ships a separate MAME4tvOS build which is intentionally not distributed here.

apps.name: qBitController
apps.subtitle: Cross-platform qBittorrent remote (Kotlin)
apps.localizedDescription: qBitController is a free and open-source qBittorrent remote client built with Kotlin Multiplatform and Compose. Control your qBittorrent WebUI from iPhone or iPad: add torrents by URL or file, pause/resume and recheck, browse file lists and set priorities, and manage categories and tags with a clean Material-style interface.

compatibility.notes: Official iOS IPA (qbitcontroller-<version>-ios.ipa) from the developer's GitHub releases; 2.x targets iOS 14. The developer's own AltStore source mirrors these builds. Distinct from qBitControl and qBitConnect, which are separate apps.

apps.name: Mini vMac
apps.subtitle: Early Macintosh emulator for iOS
apps.localizedDescription: Mini vMac for iOS emulates the earliest Apple Macintosh computers (128K, 512K, Plus and II), letting you run classic System 1 through System 7 software on modern devices. Load your own ROM and disk images, with support for external keyboards, mice and multiple emulated machine variants.

compatibility.notes: Official IPA from the developer's GitHub releases (2.6, 2024). Also distributed via the SideStore Community Source. Requires a Macintosh ROM image and system disks from a machine you own.

apps.name: StikNES
apps.subtitle: NES/Famicom emulator for modern iOS
apps.localizedDescription: StikNES is a Nintendo Entertainment System / Famicom emulator for iPhone and iPad from the StikEMU team, built for modern iOS with Metal-accelerated rendering, MFi and keyboard controller support, save states and a focus on accuracy and low latency. Load your own legally dumped ROMs.

compatibility.notes: Official IPA from the developer's GitHub releases (2.0 line requires iOS 17+). Also distributed via the SideStore Community Source.
